list_description: Countries that buy in one currency, with the catalog of what they can buy and its prices.
list_empty_description: A storefront sells only to countries in a market. Add one to start selling.
new_description: Countries that buy in one currency. Its catalog is created with it; add products to it next.
new_name_description: For staff only; shoppers see their country.
new_currency_description: What the market's prices are in. It can't change later: price lists depend on it.
new_prices_include_tax_description: On for most of Europe; off where tax is added at checkout, as in the US.
detail_prices_include_tax_description: Whether the prices shoppers in this market see already contain tax.
detail_currency_fixed: Fixed once the market is created: its price lists are in it.
detail_countries_description: Shoppers in these countries buy from this market. A country belongs to one market.
detail_countries_picker_description: Pick or search; the quick picks add only countries no other market has.
detail_countries_required: A market needs at least one country.
catalog_description: The products this market can buy. A product also needs to be active and published to the storefront's channel.
catalog_none: This market has no catalog yet, so it sells nothing.
catalog_picker_description: Shoppers in {market} can buy them once they're active and published.
price_lists_description_none: Without one, the market sells at each variant's base price (when it's in {currency}).
price_lists_description: Shoppers pay the lowest live price among these lists, or the base price where none prices a variant. Put lists together only when they should compete: a markup beside a regular list never wins.
price_lists_no_scope: Viewing price lists needs the {scope} scope.
price_lists_remove_tooltip: Remove from this market (the list stays)
price_lists_full: A catalog holds at most {max, number} price lists.
